thread:
deploy-bot: Staged rollout v2026.03.14-rc4 started to staging. Healthchecks running across 6 clusters.

pagerduty-bot: 🚨 PagerDuty: latency-service-p95 spiked above 1200ms for staging-route (service:redwood-staging-infer). Triggered page to oncall-morgan.

oncall-morgan: acked. I'm on it — grabbing logs and routing table now.

alex.k: saw the spike in NPM. Root cause looks like long tail on model-variant: rwd-13B-quant. Might be memory thrash on a subset of pods.

sasha.eng: interesting — we pushed a kernel tweak in rc4 for quant kernels. Could be a bad codepath under certain seq lengths.

oncall-morgan: initial impact: staging only, no prod routes affected yet. But rolling release policy will promote if staging ok; pausing promotion until we confirm. Pausing rollout now.

pagerduty-bot: escalation to eng-sre after 5m: paging infra-jen.

infra-jen: joining. Can you share the failing pod IDs?

oncall-morgan: logs from one representative pod:
```
I0214 12:03:45 runtime.cpp:232] kv cache miss rate 0.67
E0214 12:03:46 inference.cpp:498] slow_token_generation: 230ms per token (expected < 50ms)
W0214 12:03:47 oom-kernel: page reclamation spike
```

sasha.eng: that oom-kernel line is suspicious. rc4 changed the slab allocator hint for attention buffers. Recommend route around by switching to rwd-13B-fp16 for staging and re-run healthchecks.

alex.k: we can patch routing with the following command to prefer fp16 variant for new requests:
```
# prefer fp16 variant for staging-route
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://ops.redwood/api/v1/routes/staging-route/update -d '{"preferred_variants":["rwd-13B-fp16"]}'
```

oncall-morgan: applying now. Will hold canary promotion.

pagerduty-bot: morgan acknowledged move in PD.

qa-lee: running synthetic perf tests against rwd-13B-fp16 now. 10/10 requests <200ms p95.

infra-jen: spinning up 4 extra GPU slots in staging pool to isolate if it's scale related.

sasha.eng: good catch. Strategy: (1) Pause rollout (done), (2) Route new staging traffic to fp16 variant (done), (3) Increase staging capacity (in progress), (4) Re-run healthchecks and golden prompts. If green for 30m, we consider a rollback of the rc4 kernel tweak in main branch and rebaseline.

oncall-morgan: customer impact: none observed in prod. Internal staging tests only. Notifying release manager to hold prod promotion. @release-manager FYI — hold any auto-promotions.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused by oncall-morgan.

pagerduty-bot: incident severity: sev2 (staged rollout blocked). No customer-facing impact.

alex.k: I'll draft a rollback PR for the allocator hint; tag it as hotfix-candidate.

sasha.eng: also adding a temporary runtime metric to detect that slab reclamation pattern so we can alert before p95 crosses threshold.

oncall-morgan: timeline: 12:03 initial page -> 12:06 ack -> 12:12 routing change -> 12:20 extra capacity started -> 12:27 perf tests green. Holding for 30m of stable metrics then decide.

infra-jen: any need to run a manual canary rollback in case fp16 path also degrades? I have playbook steps ready:
```
# rollback canary
kubectl rollout undo deployment/staging-infer --to-revision=2026.03.13
```

oncall-morgan: keep rollback as fallback. For now we keep fp16 preference and monitor.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by oncall-morgan, escalated to infra-jen and sasha.eng.

qa-lee: adding automated regression test to prevent this kernel hint from shipping without perf baseline — PR coming.

sasha.eng: after 30m of stability we'll either (a) roll forward with a patched kernel, or (b) roll back rc4 from main and re-evaluate.

oncall-morgan: closing the PD page as 'mitigated in staging' but keeping thread open for root-cause / follow-up. Please update follow-up doc in runbook: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/release-rollouts#staging-latency-block

alex.k: PR #4123 created: revert allocator hint + unit perf harness added. cc @sasha.eng

infra-jen: I recorded the pod traces and uploaded to shared folder: https://storage.redwood/sessions/1965432100-trace.zip

sasha.eng: thanks all. Postmortem plan: short RCA pinned to the runbook, action items: add metric, extend synthetic golden set, add opt-in kernel A/B gating in rollout.

oncall-morgan: thread summary: staged rollout triggered latency page; paused rollout; routed staging to fp16 variant; scaled staging; perf tests green; mitigation succeeded; follow-ups assigned.

pagerduty-bot: Closing alert: automated page resolved (staging mitigation applied).

deploy-bot: When the PR lands and we verify, we can re-run a canary with tighter perf gating.

sasha.eng: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
